title: Search Results Page
description:
## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-0">:person_with_crown:</custom> User Story

**As a** shopper on a Shopify store, **I want** to see a well-organized and visually clear list of relevant products after I search for a term, **so that** I can quickly find the item I'm looking for and make a purchase decision.

---

Implement a user-friendly **search results page** that displays relevant product results. The page should be styled consistently with the store theme and include features that enhance product discoverability and conversion.

---

| Accessability | Must comply with **WCAG 2.1 AA**: keyboard navigation, screen reader support, proper color contrast, and semantic HTML. User can navigate the entire page using only a keyboard. All images and links have descriptive labels or `alt` text. Search results are announced to screen readers after submission. Filter controls are labeled and usable by assistive tech. Page meets automated accessibility checks (e.g., Lighthouse, WAVE). Manual testing confirms screen reader usability (e.g., with NVDA, VoiceOver). |  |

summary: Search results page with query highlighting, filter bar, product grid, and empty state handling.
features: Search term display with result count indicator
Filter bar for sorting and filtering results
Responsive product grid with load more pagination
shortDescription: The Search Results Page organizes search matches into a scannable product listing optimized for conversion. The SearchResultHeader displays the query term with an AmountPill indicating total matches. Results appear in a responsive product grid with filter bar controls for sorting and refinement, while the load more component enables progressive loading without page refreshes. When no products match, the page gracefully transitions to an empty state with product recommendations, and clearing the search reveals the full product catalog. SEO-friendly URLs preserve search terms and active filters for shareability.
